caption:
@barneysarc has always had oily skin, which meant finding a sunscreen he would actually want to wear every day wasn’t always easy. ☀️

During the internship, he found just the right match in our Gel Sunscreen. Its unique lightweight, airy texture felt comfortable on his oily skin, absorbed quickly, and didn’t leave behind a heavy or greasy feel. 💛

Over time, it became the one skincare step he never skips before stepping out.

For Barney, the internship wasn’t just about trying another sunscreen. It was about finding one that actually worked with his skin type and made daily sun protection easy to stick to.
